title: 복습 D: 연음·거센소리 되기
objective: Read words with linking (음악 [으막]) and aspiration (좋고 [조코]) and write how they sound in [ ].
summary: Two Korean sound changes: a final consonant moving into the next syllable, and ㅎ strengthening ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅂ, ㅈ.

task.title: Read and write the sounds
task.line: Say each item aloud, then write or choose how it really sounds in [ ].

words.exampleMeaning: This restaurant has good food and is quiet.
I'm in a bit of a hurry right now.

letters.letter: 받침 + ㅇ → moves to the next syllable (linking)
letters.as: Like 'an egg' said 'a-negg': the final sound slides over.
ㅎ adds a puff of air, like the k in 'kite'.
Same puff in reverse order, like the p in 'pie'.

exercises: Write how it sounds (linking): ① 직업 ② 발음 ③ 일요일
Write how it sounds (ㅎ comes first): ① 넣고 ② 그렇지요 ③ 하얗다
Write how it sounds (ㅎ comes second): ① 입학 ② 생각해요 ③ 밥하고
Choose the right sound: ① 옷을 ([오슬] / [오들]) ② 이렇게 ([이러게] / [이러케]) ③ 낮에 ([나세] / [나제])
Read the sentence aloud and write how it sounds: ① 집에 가요. ② 이 노래 좋지요? ③ 저녁을 먹어요.
Write how it sounds (mixed): ① 음악을 ② 좋다 ③ 급해요
answers: ① [지베 가요] ② [이 노래 조치요] ③ [저녀글 머거요]
